headline.title: Three things in AI to watch, according to a Nobel-winning economist
headline.summary: Nobel-winning economist Daron Acemoglu highlights three key areas in AI that warrant attention, following the publication of a controversial paper critical of Big Tech's approach to artificial intelligence. His insights come just months before he received the Nobel Prize in economics in 2024.

articles.title: OpenAI Campus Network: Student club interest form
articles.summary: OpenAI has launched the Campus Network to connect student clubs globally, providing access to AI tools and resources. The initiative aims to facilitate events and foster the development of AI-powered campus communities.

articles.title: Fostering breakthrough AI innovation through customer-back engineering
articles.summary: A McKinsey report highlights that organizations are realizing less than one-third of the expected value from digital investments due to a focus on technology over customer needs. The article advocates for a customer-back engineering approach to foster more effective AI innovation and avoid fragmented solutions.

articles.title: Empowerment, corrigibility, etc. are simple abstractions (of a messed-up ontology)
articles.summary: The article discusses the complexities of AI alignment, emphasizing that while AIs are often designed to enhance human agency and empowerment, the challenge lies in the inherently under-determined nature of human goals, which can be easily influenced or manipulated. It highlights the difficulty in establishing clear distinctions between beneficial guidance and manipulation in the context of AI interactions with humans.

articles.title: Google stopped a zero-day hack that it says was developed with AI
articles.summary: Google has identified and thwarted a zero-day exploit created using AI, which was intended for a mass exploitation event targeting two-factor authentication. The Google Threat Intelligence Group reported that this vulnerability was linked to prominent cybercrime actors.

articles.title: Digg tries again, this time as an AI news aggregator
articles.summary: Digg has relaunched as an AI news aggregator, aiming to provide users with a centralized platform for reading the latest developments in artificial intelligence. This marks the latest attempt by the platform to reinvent itself in the digital news landscape.

articles.title: There aren’t enough rockets for space data centers — Cowboy Space raised $275M to build them
articles.summary: Cowboy Space has raised $275 million to develop space-based data centers in response to the growing demand for AI computing. The company faces challenges due to a shortage of rockets and high launch costs for deploying these facilities in orbit.

articles.title: Live updates from Elon Musk and Sam Altman’s court battle over the future of OpenAI
articles.summary: Elon Musk and Sam Altman are currently engaged in a court battle that could significantly impact OpenAI and its flagship product, ChatGPT. Musk's lawsuit alleges that OpenAI has strayed from its original mission of developing AI for the benefit of humanity in favor of profit-driven motives.

articles.title: The new AI-powered Google Finance is expanding to Europe.
articles.summary: Google Finance is launching its AI-powered features in Europe, enhancing user experience with advanced tools for financial analysis. This expansion follows the successful rollout of the AI-driven platform in other regions.

articles.title: Joanna Stern is not a robot, but she lived with them
articles.summary: Joanna Stern, a former senior personal technology columnist for The Wall Street Journal and co-founder of The Verge, discusses her experiences living with robots in a recent podcast episode. The conversation highlights her insights into technology and its impact on daily life.

articles.title: How enterprises are scaling AI
articles.summary: Enterprises are transitioning from initial AI experiments to broader implementation by focusing on trust, governance, workflow design, and maintaining quality at scale. This strategic approach aims to enhance the overall impact of AI initiatives within organizations.

articles.title: Implementing advanced AI technologies in finance
articles.summary: AI technologies are increasingly being adopted in finance departments, often without prior oversight or strategic planning from leadership. This has created a challenge for organizations as they seek to implement governance and structure in a sector traditionally characterized by precision and control.
